subject: Mutual Action Plan draft + legal redlines — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
To: Karen Jenkins <karen.jenkins@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan draft + legal redlines — next steps

Hi Karen / Acme team,

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier today — really appreciate the clarity on your latency targets and data residency needs. As promised, attached is the initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft (20261125-MAP-draft-v1.docx) covering milestones, owners, dependencies, and a proposed target close date. Quick highlights: 

- Target close date: 2026-12-15
- Key milestones: Procurement & Legal signoff; SOC 2 evidence delivery; SSO integration; Prod smoke test / go-live plan
- Ownership: Acme legal to review and flag mandatory redlines; Redwood to own edits to our standard MSA/DPA where we can accept changes without redrafting the commercial terms
- Dependencies: SOC 2 artifacts from Redwood, SSO technical details from Acme, and procurement PO flow

Action items I propose for the MAP legal milestone (please confirm):
1) Acme legal to return redlines on MSA/DPA within 3 business days
2) Redwood legal (cc'd: Neha) to produce a redlined MSA/DPA response within 2 business days of receiving ACME's redlines
3) If critical escalation is needed, loop in Lauren for approval on SLA/penalty language exceptions

Please review the attached MAP and let me know if these ownership/timeline assumptions work for you. If Acme prefers to own the initial redline on our draft (i.e., track changes on the MSA), please confirm and attach the file.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.co@redwood.com
Attachments: 20261125-MAP-draft-v1.docx

From: Karen Jenkins <karen.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
Cc: Matthew Lee <matthew.lee@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-11-26T10:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft + legal redlines — next steps

Marissa — thanks for the MAP and the clear list. Looping in Acme Legal (Matt) and Procurement. See attached initial redlines to the MSA and DPA from our side (ACME_MSA_redlines_20261126.pdf). A few notes: 

- Our legal team prefers to return track-changed versions of the MSA/DPA; the PDF attached contains their summary comments and key change requests.
- Acme internal target: review complete within 3 business days; we'll flag any must-have changes vs. negotiables.
- For SLA uptime/credits, our SRE will reply separately with specific targets; expect that in the next 24-48 hours.

We will plan to have procurement confirm PO process after legal alignment. Please confirm who on Redwood will own producing your redlined version and expected turnaround so we can keep the MAP dates intact.

Best,
Karen Jenkins
Head of Procurement | Acme Corp
karen.jenkins@acme.com
Attachments: ACME_MSA_redlines_20261126.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>
To: Karen Jenkins <karen.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-26T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft + legal redlines — next steps

Thanks Karen — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attached summary.

Confirming Redwood proposed ownership and turnaround below so we have it in the MAP (updating the attached MAP to v2):

- Acme: mark mandatory vs. optional redlines and send the track-changed MSA/DPA (we received your summary PDF; please send track-changed doc if possible).
- Redwood (Legal, Neha) will own producing a redlined response to the MSA/DPA. Proposed SLA for legal exchange: Redwood initial redline within 2 business days of receiving ACME's track-changed version; then 3 business days for ACME to respond.
- If either side requests SLA/penalty language outside of our standard template, escalate to Lauren for approval of concession.

Dependencies and owners (as reflected in MAP v2 attached):
- SOC 2 evidence: Redwood (we will share report by 2026-11-30)
- SSO integration details: Acme to provide SAML config + test user by 2026-12-03
- Prod smoke test: joint (Redwood Eng + Acme SRE)

Neha — can you confirm that Redwood legal can produce the first redline within 48 business hours of receiving ACME's track-changed files? If helpful I can exchange files via DocuSign link or directly to your inbox.

Marissa
Attachments: 20261126-MAP-v2.docx

On 2026-11-26 10:30, Karen Jenkins wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the MAP and the clear list. Looping in Acme Legal (Matt) and Procurement. See attached initial redlines...

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.co@redwood.com>, Karen Jenkins <karen.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-27T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan draft + legal redlines — next steps

Hi all — thanks for the context. I confirm Redwood Legal will own producing redlines on our standard MSA and DPA. A few clarifications and our proposed schedule: 

- Scope: Redwood will prepare redlined MSA and DPA responses addressing Acme's comments. We will not accept broad indemnity or data residency obligations that materially change our risk profile without a business escalation.
- Timeline: I will aim to produce an initial redlined version by EOD 2026-11-29 (this is 2 business days from when we receive the ACME track-changed doc). After that, we expect up to 3 business days for Acme to review and revert. If we encounter high-priority items that require product/legal cross-team inputs (e.g., data residency or SLA credits), I'll flag them and propose an escalation path.

Open items needing input from product/eng:
- DPA: confirm any required data residency commitments and location-specific terms.
- SLA: exact uptime target and credit calculation; confirm if Acme requires PCI-level reporting or custom RMAs.

Dev — can you please link the Confluence page with SSO and integration notes so Acme has the technical dependency details?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Attachments: ACME_redlines_20261127.pdf
